newsitem.title: USA: Schenectady, NY property taxes to rise 7 pct-paper.
newsitem.headline: Schenectady, NY property taxes to rise 7 pct-paper.

text.p: New York State's Schenectady County Legislature adopted new property tax rates that includes a seven percent rise for the city property owners in 1997, the Albany Times Union said Wednesday.
County Finance Commissioner George Davidson said the apportionment burden has shifted because of changes in state equalization rates.
But property owners in five nearby towns will see their county taxes falling, with the total $44.4 million levy slipping $4,000 in 1997.
The present county tax rate for the city of $7.63 per $1,000 of assessed valuation will rise to $8.17. And the city rate will rise to $9.74 from $9.47 per $1,000.
